Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Shruti Rao. I am a 55-year-old restaurant owner living in Hyderabad. I paid Saxena Developers ₹9,39,00,000 for a flat, and possession of the flat is long overdue. My case number is C.C. No. 2701/2020 in the Hyderabad District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 70686 74087 or email shruti.rao2@example.in.
